name: Chyunn Environment Corporation
summary: Chyunn Environment Corporation functions as a leading environmental services provider in Taiwan, focusing on comprehensive waste management solutions. The company's diverse range of offerings includes household refuse collection, extensive resource recycling initiatives, and the specialized handling and disposal of both general and hazardous commercial and industrial waste streams. Furthermore, it manages construction debris, oversees facilities for the storage and disposal of earth and stone materials, and conducts machinery dismantling. Beyond these core services, Chyunn Environment also delivers environmental protection consultancy to businesses and operates a water truck transport division. The enterprise was founded in 1981 and maintains its headquarters in Tainan City, Taiwan.
